title: The End of the Click
status: Picks approved (hook A, THEN A, NOW A, NEXT A) · waiting for the voice take · no MP4 rendered

captions.text:
Every time you don’t click a link…
someone loses money.

You searched. Ten blue links.
One click paid the website.
But now AI answers on top.

One study: Google traffic to
publishers fell 40% in a year.

Condé Nast told its teams:
plan as if search is zero.

So websites may write for AIs…
not for you.

And when no one clicks…
who gets paid?
